# License

`micro_feeder.xml` is an original work, written by hand for powerio by Mohamed
Numair, with no upstream source. Its author released it under the same terms as
the powerio code, MIT OR Apache-2.0, in
<https://github.com/eigenergy/powerio/pull/631>.

`tank_feeder.xml` is an original work, written for powerio as a synthetic
fixture with no upstream source; its values are computed from the OpenDSS
micro fixtures it mirrors. It is released under the same terms as the powerio
code, MIT OR Apache-2.0.
